title: Huangqi Chifeng decoction alleviates cerebral ischemia and reperfusion injury by targeting NFKBIA, NF-kappaB1 p105 and PIAS1 to multi-dimensionally inhibit NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling: A multi-omics analysis.
authors: Chen, Xiaomin; Ma, Xiaojun; Tang, Xialin; Lin, Wenyi; Zheng, Yunhui; Zan, Jie; Ding, Yanbing
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 中药复方治疗脑缺血再灌注损伤的多组学研究，虽含分子对接但核心是NF-kB/NLRP3信号通路与药效验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cerebral ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury remains a critical challenge in ischemic stroke management, with limited therapeutic options. Huangqi Chifeng Decoction (HQCF), a classical traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formula, exhibits clinical efficacy in stroke treatment, yet its protective mechanisms remain poorly characterized. PURPOSE: This study aims to assess the protective effects of HQCF treatment on cerebral I/R injury in mice, and to uncover the underlying molecular mechanism. METHODS: The therapeutic effects of HQCF on cerebral I/R injury were evaluated by neurobehavioral tests, TTC staining, H&E staining and Nissl staining using the mouse model of middle cerebral artery occlusion-reperfusion (MCAO/R). Then, the compositional analysis was conducted using Q-Orbitrap LC-MS/MS. Subsequently, multi-omics, including proteomics, transcriptomics, metabolomics were performed to elucidate HQCF's therapeutic mechanisms. Key pathways and targets were validated through western blot, molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and immunofluorescence. Pathway specificity was further validated using the NF-kappaB pathway agonist, NF-kappaBeta activator 2. RESULTS: HQCF intervention markedly alleviated neurological deficits and reduced infarct volumes in MCAO/R mice, with concomitant improvement in histopathological features, as demonstrated by comparison with the positive control drug edaravone. Integrative multi-omics profiling revealed that HQCF mitigates I/R injury partially through inhibiting NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling, with NF-kappaB-inhibitor alpha (NFKBIA), PIAS1 and NF-kappaB1 p105, the critical inhibitors of NF-kappaB activation, as the key potential targets of HQCF. LC-MS/MS, molecular docking and CETSA studies confirmed NFKBIA, PIAS1 and NF-kappaB1 p105 represent novel pharmacological targets of Oleanolic acid, Astragaloside A and Formononetin, respectively, highlighting their critical roles in mediating HQCF's neuroprotective effects. Mechanistically, HQCF promoted NFKBIA, PIAS1 and NF-kappaB1 p105-mediated inhibition of NF-kappaB activation, thereby suppressing NLRP3/GSDMD-driven pyroptosis, eventually attenuating neuronal injury in peri-infarct regions. Additionally, in vivo experiments revealed that NF-kappaBeta activator 2 reversed the protective effects of HQCF on cerebral I/R injury. CONCLUSION: This study systematically demonstrates that HQCF mitigates cerebral I/R injury via multi-dimensionally inhibiting NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling-mediated neuronal pyroptosis, including targeting the precursor NF-kappaB1 p105, binding the NFKBIA in the cytoplasm, and targeting PIAS1 in the nuclear. These findings provide novel mechanistic insights into HQCF' therapy on cerebral I/R injury, further confirm the advantage of TCM in treating cerebrovascular disease via multitarget strategy and advance translational investigations of HQCF.
abstract_zh: 背景：脑缺血再灌注（I/R）损伤仍是缺血性卒中管理中的关键挑战，治疗选择有限。黄芪赤风汤（HQCF）作为一种经典中药方剂，在卒中治疗中显示出临床疗效，但其保护机制仍未被充分阐明。目的：本研究旨在评估HQCF治疗对小鼠脑I/R损伤的保护作用，并揭示其潜在分子机制。方法：利用小鼠大脑中动脉闭塞再灌注（MCAO/R）模型，通过神经行为学测试、TTC染色、H&E染色和尼氏染色评估HQCF对脑I/R损伤的治疗效果。随后，采用Q-Orbitrap LC-MS/MS进行成分分析。接着，进行多组学分析，包括蛋白质组学、转录组学和代谢组学，以阐明HQCF的治疗机制。通过蛋白质印迹、分子对接、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和免疫荧光验证关键通路和靶点。使用NF-kappaB通路激动剂NF-kappaBeta激活剂2进一步验证通路特异性。结果：HQCF干预显著减轻了MCAO/R小鼠的神经功能缺损并减少了梗死体积，同时改善了组织病理学特征，与阳性对照药物依达拉奉相比效果显著。整合多组学分析揭示，HQCF部分通过抑制NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号通路减轻I/R损伤，其中NF-kappaB抑制剂α（NFKBIA）、PIAS1和NF-kappaB1 p105作为NF-kappaB激活的关键抑制剂，是HQCF的潜在关键靶点。LC-MS/MS、分子对接和CETSA研究确认，NFKBIA、PIAS1和NF-kappaB1 p105分别是齐墩果酸、黄芪甲苷A和芒柄花素的新型药理学靶点，突显了它们在介导HQCF神经保护作用中的关键角色。机制上，HQCF促进NFKBIA、PIAS1和NF-kappaB1 p105介导的NF-kappaB激活抑制，从而抑制NLRP3/GSDMD驱动的焦亡，最终减轻梗死周围区域的神经元损伤。此外，体内实验显示，NF-kappaBeta激活剂2逆转了HQCF对脑I/R损伤的保护作用。结论：本研究系统证明，HQCF通过多维度抑制NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号介导的神经元焦亡来减轻脑I/R损伤，包括靶向前体NF-kappaB1 p105、结合细胞质中的NFKBIA以及靶向核内的PIAS1。这些发现为HQCF治疗脑I/R损伤提供了新的机制见解，进一步证实了中药通过多靶点策略治疗脑血管疾病的优势，并推进了HQCF的转化研究。
